prompt: Who was the building named after on South Forest Avenue, which was built around 1959-1964 and designed by the architect married to Olga Lazovic?
answer: The building is **Grady Gammage Memorial Auditorium** on South Forest Avenue in Tempe, Arizona. It was named after **Dr. Grady Gammage**, the president of Arizona State University from 1959 until his death in 1964. It was designed by **Frank Lloyd Wright**, who was married to **Olgivanna Lazovich**.
